semantic_reason: The PR addresses a reported defect (#4289) where literal UUID/binary values in queries were dumped to binary and produced invalid SQL. The core change in lib/ecto/query/planner.ex now raises an error instead of emitting invalid SQL, fixing existing incorrect behavior. Additional changes are unrelated cleanup of deprecated version checks (Decimal, Elixir 1.11 TODOs), but the primary intent and test ('raises on literal non-base binary/uuids in query') correspond to correcting a bug.
